detail.subject: ml_longterm_data_watchdog

detail.remedy: Decide and implement one of: (a) wire the agent's output to a real consumer, (b) wire a real producer to its input, or (c) take it to the board for retirement. Notify HR either way so the roster reflects reality.
detail.why: The Chairman's standing instruction: the firm must never lose track of an agent, because a key agent that quietly stops doing its job is disastrous. An agent that reads nothing anyone writes and writes nothing anyone reads is already lost — it is running and irrelevant.

detail.subject: dynamic_position_sizer
detail.detail: Merely importing dynamic_position_sizer tries to change firm state (open(position_sizer.log, 'a')). Import must be side-effect free.
detail.remedy: Move the write into a function called by main()/run(); importing a module must not mutate firm state.
detail.why: Import-time writes mean merely inspecting the firm changes it, which makes every audit unreliable and every dry run a live run.
